messages:
sam: Quick PSA — ran a 1k-request perf sweep of mixed-precision (FP8/INT8/4-bit fallback) on model redwood-13b-v2 on p4dn. Observed median per-token 38ms (expected ~32ms) and 95th jumped to 120ms (expected ~70ms). KV cache hit rate was ~83% in the run logs.

anya: Oof. Any sign it's batching or kernel choice? Do we have profiler counters?

sam: Pasted quick profiler dump: 
```
kernel_counters: matmul_int8=41%, matmul_fp8=29%, transpose=6%, softmax_fp32=8%, quant_dequant=9%, other=7%
batch_sizes: p50=1, p90=8, p99=16
kv_cache_hits: 830/1000
end_to_end: median=38ms p95=120ms
```

matt: matmul_fp8 at 29% is... unexpected. Kernel selector usually prefers INT8 for these shapes. Could the calibration tweak have widened thresholds so some matmuls choose fp8? @li, you adjusted calibration last week right?

li: Yeah I pushed a small change to reduce FP8 underflow, it relaxed the saturation threshold. I'll diff the commit/params now.

eva: Also noticing batch p90=8 / p99=16 — our continuous-batching heuristics might be grouping long sequences and causing path divergence (fp8 kernels used for larger matmuls). We need per-batch kernel breakdown, not just global counters.

perf-bot: New trace created: https://perf.redwood/trace/1772109876 — I tagged spans with kv_hit=true/false and kernel_id where available :chart_with_upwards_trend:

anya: Can we add these observability items ASAP: 1) per-token kernel_id counter in tracer 2) kv_hit boolean on per-token spans 3) batching bucket histogram (1,2,4,8,16+) 4) calibration_version label in metrics?

sam: +1 to all. Also want per-kernel latency histogram so we can see matmul_fp8 tail latency.

li: I'll revert the calibration delta locally and run an A/B (cal_v3 vs cal_v2) to see impact. If cal_v2 is faster with similar quality, we'll roll back and open a perf regression PR.

matt: For immediate mitigation, consider a temporary routing policy: force INT8 matmul for seq > 512 or if kv_hit_rate > 80%. That should keep the fp8 path off the hot tail.

eva: I'll add lightweight dashboard panels: per-kernel pct, per-kv-hit latency breakdown, batch-size distribution, and a kernel-selection heatmap across seq_len x batch. ETA tomorrow EOD.

sam: Action items / owners: li -> calibration diff + A/B (today EOD), eva -> dashboards (tomorrow), anya -> instrumentation PR (per-token kernel counters + cal_version in metrics), matt -> temporary routing policy. I'll file a followup message with exact run ids and PR links.

sam: Attached a couple of raw logs showing the pattern: 
```
[1745.23] req=349 kernel=matmul_fp8 seq=640 batch=12 kv_hit=true lat_token=95ms
[1745.24] req=350 kernel=matmul_int8 seq=32 batch=2 kv_hit=true lat_token=30ms
```

li: Started the cal A/B run (id=1772114000). Will post perf summary when done.

matt: Quick note — throttling batching for long sequences reduces fp8 occurrences but increases tokens/sec cost. Document tradeoffs in the PR.

sam: Agreed. Prioritizing tail SLA for this customer workload for now.

anya: One more ask: add kernel-selection counters at the batching layer as well (so we can correlate chosen kernel to batch_size and seq_len before the runtime reorders ops).

eva: Will include that in the dashboard pipeline. Also adding alerts if matmul_fp8 pct > 20% for high-seq workloads.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll loop back once li posts the A/B.
